rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.ne: समूह अभ्यास – उदाहरणका रूपमा दिइएका गतिविधिहरूको मिलान
rows.bt: Group exercise – matching the activities given as examples
rows.note: Proposed recurring term: group exercise = समूह अभ्यास; not added to the frozen glossary.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: In your group, look at the activity you’ve been given and match it with one of the MSP activities hanging on the wall.
rows.ne: आफ्नो समूहमा, तपाईंहरूलाई दिइएको गतिविधि हेर्नुहोस् र त्यसलाई भित्तामा झुन्ड्याइएका MSP गतिविधिहरू मध्ये कुनै एउटासँग मिलाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: In your group, look at the activity given to you and match it with one of the MSP activities hung on the wall.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: When you have decided, tape your activity card to the MSP activity that it matches.
rows.ne: निर्णय गरिसकेपछि, आफ्नो गतिविधि कार्ड त्यससँग मेल खाने MSP गतिविधिमा टेपले टाँस्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: After you have made a decision, use tape to stick your activity card onto the MSP activity that matches it.
rows.note: The back-translation places the card next to the matching MSP activity rather than attaching it to that activity. The revision makes the attachment target explicit.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.ne: 25 मिनेट
rows.bt: 25 minutes

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Exercise - Matching real activities to the MSP
rows.ne: अभ्यास – वास्तविक गतिविधिहरूलाई MSP सँग मिलाउने
rows.bt: Exercise – matching actual activities with MSP

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Individually or with colleagues from your own organisation:
rows.ne: व्यक्तिगत रूपमा वा आफ्नै संस्थाका सहकर्मीहरूसँग:
rows.bt: Individually or with colleagues from your own organization:

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Review your existing programmes and identify which MSP activities you are currently implementing
rows.ne: आफ्ना विद्यमान कार्यक्रमहरूको समीक्षा गर्नुहोस् र हाल कुन-कुन MSP गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गरिरहनुभएको छ भन्ने पहिचान गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Review your existing programs and identify which MSP activities you are currently implementing.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: For each activity, use a sticky note to write: organization, target group, locations.
rows.ne: प्रत्येक गतिविधिका लागि टाँसिने नोटमा संस्था, लक्षित समूह र स्थानहरू लेख्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For each activity, write the organization, target group and locations on a sticky note.
rows.note: Proposed recurring term: sticky note / post-it note = टाँसिने नोट; not added to the frozen glossary.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: When you are done, stick your post-it notes up on the corresponding flip charts.
rows.ne: लेखिसकेपछि, आफ्ना टाँसिने नोटहरू सम्बन्धित फ्लिपचार्टहरूमा टाँस्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: After writing, stick your sticky notes on the relevant flipcharts.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term टाँसिने नोट for post-it note, consistent with sticky note in the preceding instruction; not added to the frozen glossary.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: For planned activities (not yet implemented), use a different colour and include planned start date
rows.ne: योजना गरिएका तर अझै कार्यान्वयन नगरिएका गतिविधिहरूका लागि फरक रङ प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र सुरु गर्ने योजनाबद्ध मिति पनि समावेश गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Use a different color for activities that are planned but have not yet been implemented, and also include the planned start date.

rows.en: Choose an activity you are implementing

rows.bt: Choose one activity that you are implementing.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Review the checklist of core actions
rows.ne: मुख्य कार्यहरू समावेश भएको जाँचसूचीको समीक्षा गर्नुहोस्।

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Note which ones you have completed/not completed.
rows.ne: कुन-कुन कार्यहरू पूरा गर्नुभएको छ र कुन-कुन पूरा गर्नुभएको छैन भनेर टिपोट गर्नुहोस्।
